requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The system shall log all user actions related to book borrowing and returning for accountability.
The system shall enforce a maximum of 5 books per member to ensure responsible borrowing.
The system shall automatically notify members of overdue books via digital notifications to promote responsibility and reduce paper waste.
The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding library services.
The system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.
The system shall ensure that no member can borrow more than 5 books simultaneously.
The system shall log all transactions for audit purposes.
The system shall track and notify members of overdue books within 24 hours of the due date.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall maintain a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of book search queries.
The system shall allow a maximum of 5 simultaneous book borrow operations per member.
The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers.
The library management system shall implement a recycling program for damaged books.
